title: One of the Masses Erotic Hypnosis
description:
The echoing chorus of my devoted worshippers rings in your ears as you slip under the spell of my powerful voice. You fall deeper, repeating the same mantras, joining the masses who adore me, who serve me, who obey me. Who say Yes, Mistress Calia.

It’s one thing to be hypnotized by just me, but when the real voices of others who listen and fall into my hypnotic power can be heard, growing in volume, in number, you may find yourself wanting to join them. To be part of something larger. To be one of the masses.

Don’t worry, you’ll retain your identity after the session, but for the time you’re with me, for these 40 hypnotic minutes, you’ll be a part of a hive mind with a simple mantra to repeat, and your only desire will be worshipping your hypnotic Mistress. Just like everyone else.

Let me take you deep into this femdom hypno file and show you how powerful I am, with concrete proof of my power in what you hear as you fall ever deeper under hypnosis.

Art by Aleriia_V

A huge thanks to those who lent their voices to this file, you are amazing!
author: Mistress Calia
